messages:
Jordan M: Heads-up — ORCHID Health wants to revise their renewal and move a portion of traffic to Dedicated + Private. They propose a 3-year commit with step-down pricing (year1 heavy), want price protection, and ask for an onboarding credit to cover migration. Also asking for a VPC peering POC in two weeks. Need Deal Desk, RevOps, Legal + SE.

Priya K: Quick numbers so we can frame the packet: current commit = 240000 ARR, ask = 360000 ARR (net uplift 120k). They want a 15% concession on year1 only, and a cap on overage charges for the first 6 months. They also requested a multi-year ratecard lock.

Sam R (SE): POC requirements from ORCHID: private peering, SCIM SSO, audit logs, BYOK support, and persistent KV cache retention across restarts. Typical load for pilot: 40 TPS sustained bursts -> peaks 200 TPS, average seq ~5k. For Dedicated sizing I recommend 3 x A10s or 1 x H100 depending on response latency needs. Will run a quick perf matrix and post tomorrow.

Lara V (Deal Desk): Please submit a Deal Desk packet with ARR math, proposed concession (15% Y1 or alternate service credit), term structure (3yr step-down), overage cap request, and migration credit ask. We need justification (reason code: "commit+retention"), and expected margin impact. If you mark this as high-priority we can get a 48h turnaround.

Jordan M: ARR calc (draft):
```
Current commit: 240000 ARR
Requested commit (yr1): 360000 ARR
Net uplift: 120000 ARR
15% concession on uplift (yr1) = 18,000 (one-time or invoice credit)
Proposed onboarding credit = value of 1 month Dedicated (~12k) to cover migration/validation
```
They also asked for a T&Cs clause to cap overage to 1.2x list rates for first 6 months and a 60-day early termination right during migration window.

revops-bot: Note: discounts >12% on committed ARR require RevOps + CFO signoff. Service credits (non-invoice) may be handled by Ops but require capacity reservation confirmation.

Sam R: Security/SW requirements: RSA certs acceptable, they want HSM-backed BYOK with EKM flow, and PCI SAQ questions for payment-sensitive PII. We need Legal + Security input on PCI scope. I'll file infra ticket for HSM availability and schedule the pilot env.

ops-bot: provisioning request logged: env=ORCHID-POC-01 owner=@Sam R ETA=72h. Tagged to #eng-infra for peering and HSM gating.

Lara V: Action items — Jordan: assemble Deal Desk packet and margin calc. Sam: post perf bench + infra gating checklist. Priya: propose alternate concession (10% + 1 month service credit) if RevOps pushes back. Legal: please confirm acceptability of 60-day ET during migration.

Priya K: Customer timeline: ORCHID wants an LOI by COB Friday to keep migration window. They prefer onboarding credit > invoice credit.

Jordan M: Are there operational differences between onboarding credit vs invoice credit for approvals?

Lara V: Onboarding credit is treated as a service credit (reduces usage invoiced) — easier for RevOps margins but requires capacity booking. Invoice credit reduces billed revenue and hits finance booking. Different approval thresholds.

Sam R: Operational note — if we grant service credit we must reserve capacity for pilot month and mark as non-billable. That needs confirmation from Eng Infra before we promise.

Jordan M: OK I'll draft the packet and flag as high priority. Will post here with the ARR table and ask for a quick sign-off chain. Will also ping Legal for PCI/ET confirmation.

Lara V: :white_check_mark: Once packet is in, I'll open the RevOps route and include CFO if needed. If RevOps declines >12% we'll fallback to 10% + 1 month service credit.

Jordan M: Thanks — I'll post before EOD. ORCHID prefers the service credit path, so I'll note that in the packet.

Priya K: FYI: include sample SOW language for onboarding credit, and a clause for limited overage cap (6 months). Customers often accept provisional non-binding T&Cs to start pilot.

Jordan M: Got it. Posting packet in thread soon and will @mention when ready.
